tool.name: nanomonsv_parse
tool.description: Parse all the supporting reads of putative somatic SVs using nanomonsv. After successful completion, you will find supporting reads stratified by deletions, insertions, and rearrangements. A precursor to "nanomonsv get"

param.name: threads
param.label: Number of Threads
param.help: Number of CPU threads to use

tool.help:
**nanomonsv_parse**
Parse all the supporting reads of putative somatic SVs using nanomonsv. After successful completion, you will find supporting reads stratified by deletions, insertions, and rearrangements. A precursor to "nanomonsv get"
**nf-core Module Information:**
- Module: nanomonsv/parse - Container: biocontainers/nanomonsv:0.8.0--pyhdfd78af_0
**Usage:** This tool provides the functionality from the nf-core module within Galaxy workflows.
